description: 人格化的太阳运行者，与太阳运行体系共同构成天体秩序。
fullDescription: 《女预言家之歌》和《欺骗古鲁菲》将Sól作为人格化的太阳运行者；《欺骗古鲁菲》第11章进一步给出她驾车以及马匹Árvakr、Alsviðr等信息。卡图应强调‘驾驶/运行太阳’而非通用太阳女神光环。
roleInSeries: 建立白昼与时间循环的视觉锚点。

sourceRefs.note: 日月在初始秩序中的运行。
Sól驾驶太阳相关车乘；太阳运行体系。

visualThesis: 处于高速但受控的太阳运行状态，人物是驾驶者/运行者，太阳与车乘系统是明确关系，不是站着发光的太阳女神。

sourceBoundFacts: 《欺骗古鲁菲》描述太阳车与马匹
interpretationNotes: 具体服饰、发色、容貌不明
是否把完整太阳车同时放入角色卡属于构图选择；神物卡会单独表现太阳之车
canon.worldState: 成熟天穹运行秩序已建立，但尚未进入诸神黄昏。

instructions: 与Máni形成暖/冷与运动节奏对照，但不是换色同构图
与Sköll：Sól是秩序运行主体，Sköll是追逐压力

visual.detailHierarchy: 脸、上身和运行关系高细节；太阳与背景中低细节。
visual.subjectSeparation: 用暖光与较冷天空分离主体，避免白色过曝吞掉脸。

prompt.draft: Create Sól as the personified sun-runner in Norse myth, shown as an active driver/runner within the ordered motion of the sun rather than a generic glowing sun goddess. Use a clear human figure, controlled forward motion, restrained warm solar light and only a partial hint of the chariot/horse system so the character remains primary. No giant ornamental halo, angel wings, hand-held sun, Greek/Roman sun-god styling or cosmic particle overload. Distinguish her from Máni by warm directional motion and from Sköll by being the ordered celestial mover rather than the pursuer. Crop-safe head and upper torso, simple sky background.

Visual thesis: 处于高速但受控的太阳运行状态，人物是驾驶者/运行者，太阳与车乘系统是明确关系，不是站着发光的太阳女神。

Identity anchors: 人形太阳运行者；受控运动；太阳/车乘关系；非静态光环女神

Must keep: 主体头脸安全；暖光集中在一侧；背景天空简化

Must avoid: 巨大光环占满画面；天使翼；希腊太阳神模板；手托太阳魔法师；满屏宇宙粒子

Composition: camera dynamic three-quarter; shot upper-body runner/driver; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Color and material guidance: palette 旧金；白金；炽橙；烟灰蓝; materials 织物；马具/车乘暗示；太阳光；风; mood radiant；controlled-motion；solar；restrained.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010013；1003010014. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: giant halo ornament；angel wings；holding sun；Greek sun god；cosmic clutter；Sköll-like beast；Máni clone；glossy game-CG；typography; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete portrait 9:16 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 1620x2880 pixels.
